title: Sourcing simulator
lede: Build a cart, place the customer and run it: the advisor answers with its plans, as cards or as one table. Nothing is sent to a channel from here.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the sourcing simulator
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor's run grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

run.needs: Add at least one line with an item and a quantity, and place the customer, to run.
run.badLine: Each line needs an item and a whole quantity above zero.
run.badPoint: The customer's point needs a latitude and a longitude.
run.badTotal: The cart value is an amount in riyals.
run.stale: The cart has changed since this run. Press Run to plan it again.

cart.title: Start a run
cart.timeHint: Today, local time. Empty plans for now.
cart.goodsTotalHint: Riyals, optional. Without it the fee is the lowest total's row.

customer.title: The customer
customer.hint: Click the map to place the customer.
customer.mapLabel: Map: click to place the customer
customer.cannotDraw: The map cannot be drawn here. Type the customer's point instead.

plans.title: Plans
plans.none: Build a cart, place the customer and press Run. The plans appear here.

card.shortFigure: Line {{line}} is planned on a short stock figure at this store.

ending.label: Ending
ending.BEST_FOUND: Best found: the work budget ran out

fallback.title: The simple plan answered
fallback.body: The search failed, so the advisor answered with its simple plan. It is not the best plan the advisor can find.

hiddenAs.NEARLY_SAME: Nearly the same as {{as}}: {{minutes}} min and {{riyals}} apart.
hiddenAs.OVER_MOST_SHOWN: More plans than the most shown at once.

ADVISE-400.title: The request was refused
ADVISE-400.body: The advisor could not read part of this cart. Check the lines, the channel and the customer's point, then run again.

ADVISE-401.title: You are signed out
ADVISE-401.body: Your session has ended. Sign in again to run the simulator.

ADVISE-403.title: Not allowed
ADVISE-403.body: Your account may not run the sourcing advisor, or not for this channel.

ADVISE-404.title: Not found
ADVISE-404.body: The order, the weight set or the earlier run was not found, or is no longer held. Run the cart again.

ADVISE-421.title: This channel is not served
ADVISE-421.body: The advisor does not plan for this channel. Choose another channel.

ADVISE-422.title: No place to plan for
ADVISE-422.body: Place the customer on the map, then run again.

ADVISE-423.title: Too many lines
ADVISE-423.body: The cart has more lines than the advisor plans at once. Remove some lines, then run again.

ADVISE-424.title: The weight set is not valid
ADVISE-424.body: The weight set's values fail the check a save makes. Correct them, then run again.

ADVISE-429.title: Too many runs
ADVISE-429.body: Too many runs in a minute. Wait a moment, then try again.

ADVISE-500.title: No plan could be built
ADVISE-500.body: The search failed and the simple plan could not be built, though stores could serve this cart. The run's figures are held for a developer.

ADVISE-503.title: The advisor is switched off
ADVISE-503.body: The advise door is switched off just now. Try again later.

ADVISE-504.title: The reads took too long
ADVISE-504.body: The stock, distance and slot reads did not finish in time. No plan was made.

ADVISE-511.title: The advisor is busy
ADVISE-511.body: There was no place in the stock read. No plan was made. Try again in a moment.

ADVISE-512.title: The stock figures could not be read
ADVISE-512.body: The stock read failed or was late. No plan was made.

ADVISE-513.title: A table could not be read
ADVISE-513.body: The advisor could not read one of its own tables. No plan was made.

denied.title: Not allowed
denied.body: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor's run grant.

unknown.title: The run failed
unknown.body: Something went wrong running this cart. Try again in a moment.

tabs.label: More about the run
tabs.pending: This tab is not built yet. It comes with a later release of the simulator.
